attchmntText: Nagarjuna Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
desc: Reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
voiceSummary: Nagarjuna Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited disclosed reasons for delaying the submission of un-audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company was required to file by November 14, 2026. The delay is attributed to a deteriorating financial situation and lack of new cash flows from the government over the past few quarters. The company has been unable to settle critical operational dues such as salaries, utilities, and rents. These resource constraints have hindered the finalization of the financial results. The company stated it will submit the results on or before December 01, 2026.
